run_poincare_maps_cli: run the Poincare maps CLI to compute 2D embeddings of a dataset like ToggleSwitch with default settings
compute_poincare_maps_function: compute Poincare embeddings from feature matrices and labels using the compute_poincare_maps function with custom hyperparameters
run_poincare_maps_custom_dataset: run the Poincare maps CLI on a custom dataset with specified KNN neighbors, distance function, and learning rate
run_poincare_maps_visualize: run the Poincare maps CLI to compute embeddings and generate Poincare disc visualizations with optional rotation
review_compute_poincare_maps: review the compute_poincare_maps function to understand how RFA similarity matrices are computed and optimized with Riemannian SGD
